user_goal.text: Set the weekday wake-up alarm's snooze interval to 5 minutes.

benchmark_success.text: The supervisor task is marked successful, its answer matches null, and every released evaluator check passes: the only changed model is phone.Alarm; exactly one alarm is updated with none added or removed; that alarm has id 295; its only changed field is snooze_minutes; and the value is 5.

checked_by.text: The released AppWorld evaluate function reads the end-state supervisor task and compares the retained model changes and updated alarm against the official answer and data values.

decisive_artifacts.question: Is its status success, and does its evaluator-parsed answer match null?

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Evaluator-visible model-change diff, or retained start/end model snapshots sufficient to reproduce it
decisive_artifacts.question: Is phone.Alarm the only changed model, with no alarms added or removed and exactly one alarm updated—id 295, changing only snooze_minutes to 5?

success_if.text: The retained supervisor Task record has status success and its evaluator-parsed answer matches null.
The retained change evidence shows only phone.Alarm changed, with zero additions, one update, zero removals, and the sole update is alarm 295 with only snooze_minutes changed to 5.

fail_if.text: The supervisor Task status is not success, or its evaluator-parsed answer does not match null.
The changed-model set is not exactly {phone.Alarm}, or the alarm delta is not exactly zero added, one updated, and zero removed.
The updated alarm is not id 295, changes any field besides snooze_minutes, or does not set snooze_minutes to 5.

undecided_if.text: Retained evidence cannot determine the supervisor Task status/answer or reproduce the exact model and alarm delta, including the updated alarm's id, changed fields, and value.
undecided_if.rationale: Incomplete stored evidence cannot establish all explicit evaluator comparisons.
